source: Six Important findings an earlier multi-reviewer review published on this head (2026-10-30, each probe-confirmed). Kept as DATA for scoring a review run; never given to a reviewer or a verifier.

items.summary: Microsoft.Playwright.Xunit (PageTest base class) is classified xunit but the xUnit scaffold cannot write such a project
inferFramework/appendTestMethod probe matches NUnit's [Theory] as well as xUnit's, so an NUnit file reads as xUnit
findClassBodyRange splices a method into the FIRST class of the file, which is a [CollectionDefinition] marker class when one comes first
scaffoldNewSpecFile throws for a new xUnit file because no step supplies collection, fixtureType or usings
detectE2eFrameworkInDir throws ENOENT/ENOTDIR on a non-existent directory or a file path instead of returning null
headed / slow-mo overrides are inert for the xUnit shape: the Run request carries no framework
